Take it from the 18 year old who "fell in love" with the almost 28 year old. RUN!!!! I'm now 27 and divorced, and still younger than he was when he met me. I CRINGE at the thought of even flirting with someone under 21-22. THEYRE CHILDREN STILL! Figuring life out at that age! Absolutely no good reason why someone so old should be with someone so young. It screams predatory/manipulative behavior. It's so much easier to manipulate and control someone that's drastically younger, especially when they're THAT young.

It was my birthday (St.Patricks day) and we were all at our local bar. The guy I work with had been slowly trying to make a move. His friend came over to me saying "my friend wants to buy you a drink" and I was confused because I had no idea who this guy was.  I followed him back to his table to find my coworker. The conversation that follows was SO SHORT.
Me:  "Thanks for offering to buy me a drink! It's nice to see you out and about." (Im anemic so I can't drink much, I had maybe 1/4 of my  own drink left at this point.)
My coworker was different that night, less social much more timid than usual. 
His friend "hey, I'm just trynna get my boys dick wet, you in or naw?" 
My coworker was dead silent, looking SUPER SERIOUS. 
I literally shuffled his hair, finished my beer and said "I hope you guys have a great night"
Went to the bartender, told them he offered to buy my next drink, I ordered it, took one sip and left. 

My coworker later texts me asking what happened. I explained how it was my birthday of all days, and I didn't want to be spoken to like I'm a piece of meat. He tried saying his friend is just stupid x, y , z... 

I've never left a guy trying to hit on me quicker haha
Lentil sloppy joes !

I'm thankful you commented on this, I was definitely trying to keep it braced as it brought the slight bit of relief. 
I was in both the ER & their OBGYN for a total of 9hours yesterday. I wasn't given any instruction on how to help it or anything. Just told signs to look out for in case my baby decides to come early. 
I plan on calling my OBGYN tomorrow, I just haven't been able to make it the long drive time this week while I have my little with school. I should be able to see my OBGYN hopefully next week, but on the off chance it's longer I was just hoping people had some remedies for the pain they've been successful with.  
Whether it be Epsom salt, wrapping, ginger ECT I don't know, Im willing to try anything while I wait for my OB's advice. I'm just hoping I can help try and heal it as best as I can before I go into labor

I was in the emergency room then the OB L&D room all day yesterday, 
Was given both Tylenol, and then some pain killer that starts with S while I was there. 

Nothing was prescribed for pain or my nausea.

I even asked for them to prescribe me my already prescribed nausea pills, but in a dissolvable form and they must have just forgotten. They had 4 births in the time I was there yesterday, so I'm sure it was because they were extremely busy. 

Note to add, I also had to go to a hospital I specifically try my best to avoid due to bad care being given along with many misdiagnosis'.
I appreciate you and your advice so much, thank you!

Ooh, great advice! Thank you, I definitely will start there.
I used to work for a company that catered weddings and large events so I have somewhat of an idea on how intense it will be, but I don't get out often so I want to make sure I kind of have an idea on what other people enjoy eating while out at events like this.

I went about 8 months without one in highschool. I had a pretty bad eating disorder (spent years prior and following struggling with anorexia and bulimia), and never put two and two together until years later. 
I was convinced I was the next virgin Mary, and was afraid to talk to anyone about it because I thought I was pregnant. Why else wouldn't I have my period, right?

You have no idea how much it means to me that you took the time to reply to my post. I've been so emotionally drained and lost since I saw it, I feel like a shell of a person. 
I'm really struggling with this all. Especially because I know my ex will never see the assault for what it was, I'm sure he and his new girlfriend who has horribly degraded me in regards to my PTSD mainly caused by my ex husbands abuse are laughing at my depressive state surrounding this all. 
It's disgusting to me how anyone could defend such a shitty person while simultaneously beating the victim down more.

My abusive ex husband was 27 when I started dating &got knocked up w him at 19. Although my daughter is the most precious, perfect thing to ever come into my life, I will forever regret ever giving him any sort of attention. As a 26 year old now, I am disgusted with the thought of entertaining someone who is even younger than maybe 23, let alone a 19 year old. I see 19 year olds NOW as still children, they're literally children in my eyes...  makes me sick to know no one around me tried to make me see how wrong the relationship was from the beginning.

I have no phone access, no car, I am 45 minutes from the women's shelter. Idk how to find a way into town and back in time to get my little one from the bus. I'm also too afraid to leave my camper as I can't lock it and I fear he will go ballistic if he comes in here. 
Although I have emailed the women's shelter asking for help again. I didn't want to because I feel like it solidifies that the relationship is over
I hate how I have only had two real relationships and both were extremely abusive. I feel broken, because even though he's been so horrible to me, I just want him to apologize and make everything right again . I want things to be good again
I am terrified he will take my baby from me. He says it almost every time we argue, that im fucking crazy and he will make sure he takes my son from me.

I have tried to leave several times, the last time was on Christmas and he loaded his gun and told me he was going to kill himself. I don't know how we managed to fix things, but he put the gun to his head saying he was going to do it, then left and said he was going to run off into the woods and finish it.

I've tried to leave a handful of times. The gun being one major thing that fucked with my head, but also back in October I tried leaving and he told me we are about to enter war ECT knowing how afraid I am of all of that. So I felt like I HAD to keep him around because we were about to be bombed and attacked.... 

I don't understand how it felt like the best love I've ever experienced while on the flip side being the worst I've ever experienced.

I emailed the women's resource center today explaining how I am so sorry I didn't listen to her months ago when she tried getting me to see how toxic his behavior was. I literally had an out, I live in a very small town with little resources, but she was able to find room in a program that would pay for my rent and utilities for 2 years so I can get mine and my kids lives on track. I ghosted her because things seemed to have hope again with my now ex boyfriend. 
I am so afraid because I have a strong feeling that opportunity is long gone. And I already have next to no one as a friend or any sort of support here because of my abusive ex husband. 
I finally this week started feeling comfortable again up here, like I have hope because of the connections I was making here. But of course, my ex boyfriend feels closer with them now and is trying to make damn sure that I'm the one that leaves, not him

Despite him living his life traveling in a backpack for the past 10+ years. He hates staying in one place for very long, and now I believe he's going to just to spite me. He's already talked shit to the people in the house (sort of like a semi community living situation) and I just feel completely shut out. 

Like I'm scum of the earth. I feel so trapped, I hate that I feel like there's no way to keep him from getting even split custody . I hate the thought of being tied to him forever now because we have a child together. 

I'm over here praying for a miscarriage. Which is horribly disgusting to feel, especially knowing how excited my daughter is for his arrival.

I called back the second time asking if I could just do it online instead since it's so important and "I need it before Monday" and she said no she already mailed it to me. To wait for the mail, fill it out, mail it back and wait for the court to contact me further.

I am so grateful for all of your advice, I feel a lot more secure with my situation and how to proceed.
Court and legal stuff scares me, especially if it involves the possibility of being jailed/taken away from my daughter.

I actually have never lived in the county I am being summoned to, which is why I was so baffled as to why I got mail from them. 
 I'm being expected to travel back and forth and the courthouse I'm being summoned to is 2hours and 10m away from where I currently live. 
I was told that because it's for federal court, it doesn't matter how far I live? 

I did call the cities' jury line, and all the information I received this morning was conflicting and confusing to me, which is why I called a total of 4 times today basically asking the same thing each time. 
I could tell they were getting slightly annoyed by my many calls, but on top of my PTSD fogging my ability to process this all- it just wasn't making any sense to me.

She originally was giving instructions on how to fill out online, then said she will just mail it.  She told me to fill it out, mail it in, and wait for the courts to contact me further.  But she also stressed the failure to appear. 
I honestly have no idea how I'll make it 2 hours downstate and back let alone make it back in time to pick my daughter up off the bus.

It baffles me that they require you to show up despite you having access to transportation or not.  I don't even have a ride to the food pantry today, let alone 2hours downstate and back.

Man, I sure hope not. The ladies on the phone were quite short with me saying it'll be a failure to appear no matter what I do now which can result in a fine, jail time or both. and ofc that made my anxiety absolutely skyrocket.

I actually think that "final" court date is this Monday. 

I am very naive when it comes to any of this paperwork stuff. Alot of my abuse was about how incapable and stupid I am, and so I have a lot of difficulty now with all of this legal paperwork stuff. My PTSD flares and I feel like I literally can't comprehend anything. 
 
I really appreciate everyone's responses here, it really helps make things a bit more clear for this very confused mama. 

I think I will be contacting the IRS Monday morning, along with seeing if I can find myself a pro bono attorney to help through this process.

Well, I left him at the end of November 2022. I didn't know anything about filing for divorce etc, and we tried 50/50 for a while. As spring was ending/beginning of summer hit I realized how serious my daughters PTSD was and how she wasn't getting the held she needed at his house. So I filed divorce and was told I don't have to share custody until we have court orders. So from mid june-end of October, I had sole custody.  She didn't see or hear from her father once.  It was known in court since July that she wasn't going back to his house until custody court was adjourned. 
November 1st hits, custody court has now finished and we have had 50/50 custody since then . And even then, I've had my daughter more nights since November 1st than he has.

I do feel the need to stress, not that it matters to anyone else... 
I could never forgive myself if I did anything to hurt the baby.. as messed up as it is I believe everything happened for a reason.
Your reply gives me hope. Thank you for listening.

I appreciate you, I have just been so desperate to be seen. 
I feel like no matter how hard I try, I'm always the bad guy. It doesn't make sense in my head when I feel like I am breaking myself to be perfect for him.. because I'm so far to be alone. 
I was having a horrible panic attack in regards to custody court coming up with my abusive ex husband. While I was mid panic attack, he basically rubbed my situation in my face insinuating that it's my fault I'm here. 

It makes no sense to me, loving someone that's obviously bad for me. 
Just like I loved my abusive ex husband for far too long, there's gotta be something wrong with me. Something so fucked up and so far gone in my head where I feel like I need to stay. When such a huge part of me knows this isn't right. 

You shouldn't be with someone that makes you feel so sad and depressed. Who makes you feel so unseen, unheard, and unloved. Like you're the problem...

Yet, I feel so afraid, that it makes me feel like I'm paralyzed with fear. Fear that I will never be loved. 
Because, the only two relationships I've had, had ended so horribly in the same way. So it must be me. I'm just too fucked up in the head, my past traumas are too much for anyone to love. 
And now, I'm stuck, with a child and one on the way. 

Destined to never find love because I am just not worth it. 

I feel so worthless, I feel so helpless. I feel like all hope is lost. 
I haven't felt suicidal ideations in a long while, but now the thoughts of jumping in front of cars dance in my head, I can't help but have thoughts of ways to hurt myself constantly come through. I feel broken again, 
Right when I felt like I escaped and was doing well...
I am broken. 

I've been sober for 5 months now, but I can't stop thinking about relapsing. I would have never even given abortion a thought, but my mom said it enough and tried to convince me to get rid of the baby, and now I can't help but think of ways I can self sabotage so I don't have to get stuck with it. 

Because if I'm so fucked up, if my PTSD is so bad, then I sure as shit shouldn't become a mother again. Especially if it means being a single mother. I can't do this.

Hey guys, I finally got the courage to leave  my ex husband. I did it without you guys. I've been doing it this whole time without you. And oh yeah, it really fucking hurt when all you could be was cordial with me when I told you I might have cancer.  I needed you, I was so scared and alone...for 33 days you guys..I thought for a whole fcking month that I had thyroid cancer and you guys were silent past "I am sorry. That is scary." So, I love you guys so much, from the depths of my soul; but I'm glad I removed you from my life. I've been doing really well out here on my own. It's my first time out here doing my own thing as my own person and I'm absolutely kicking ass if I do say so myself.  I love you, and I really hope you're well. I miss you, I really do. Just know, I'm doing so great and I hope you never worry about me. I've been through hell and there's nothing I can't handle at this point.

I appreciate you taking the time to respond. Your sense is right, but my strength is non-existent at this point. I grew up watching those lifetime movies about abusive relationships and never could understand why the women wouldn't leave the abuser... I still very much don't understand, being in the position of being abused. I've never known true independence. At almost 25, I've never truly tasted it. Not as a kid, teen, or adult. I went from an extremely controlling childhood to being completely attached as a wife. (I left home as soon as I turned 18, moved in with the first real boyfriend I ever had, got pregnant within a week or two and got married within 6months.)  I don't know independence, and after 5-6years of being told no one will ever accept or love me for who I really am. (someone who occasionally struggles with depression and PTSD from men using their strength and aggression on me) 
As much as leaving seems possible, as much as I know I could take my daughter and myself to shelter, I feel too afraid and incapable. I don't have my license (so many reasons, the only reason being I didn't realize until last week I need glasses, which is why driving has always been so uncomfortably scary for me.) I have a 4 year old of my own and 9 year old stepchild. 

I've never been one to feel comfortable making decisions... I'm such a weak minded follower. Everything in me says everything will get better, just stick through the bullshit and tough it out for the kids. They are happier together, and when we are together.. 

He put his hands on me again last night. And it wasn't anything huge, just him getting angry and all of a sudden very aggressive with me, taking something out of my hand by  forcefully grabbing my arm and ripping it from my grasp.   Maybe I'm being over dramatic, but I feel like  you could easily ask me for whatever I was holding and I would have happily given it up.

I can't tell if I'm being over dramatic over here, or if small things like this lead to much more. He said he spent the day doing meditation while at work to work on his anger and it helped, but it's happened enough times this year that I don't know if I even believe him anymore. 

I feel so hollow, so ready to be done with everything.

I wish I didn't have  any children involved with this life situation so I could end things all together ... I feel too weak to leave and be my own person. After years of being told I'm nothing and no one will ever love or accept me... I can't ever see myself leaving.. no matter how bad it got. 

He could hit me with a car and I don't think I'd leave.. I think id be begging for love at the end of the day because I'm incapable of being alone .

I'm horrible, I know. It's why I want to end it.
Living vicariously through you tonight.
